# Student-story calibration

Share with caveats. Partial validation. Release 0.19.0.

12 fictional activity-level stories, 48 paired variations, 11 explicit plans. Stories informed tuning; they are not a holdout sample or observed students.

See dist/calibration.html for findings, sources, before/after interpretation and limits.

## Quality and usefulness

| Category | Observed defects | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Usefulness & completeness | 0 / 4 | Student stories, explanations, plans and external comparisons reviewed. Real-student outcome validation remains unavailable. |
| Analytical clarity | 0 / 3 | Interests, task choices and aptitude limits are separate. Ties and broad answers are explicit. |
| Visual & interaction consistency | 0 / 4 | Report, broad-answer view, conflicting-clue cards and resumed clinical follow-up checked. Other browser paths were sampled. |

## Analytical correctness and robustness

| Category | Observed defects | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Source authority & confidence | 0 / 3 | O*NET methodology; CareerOneStop skills and values design. Live CareerOneStop result agreement was not measured. |
| Scoring & value accuracy | 0 / 18 | Six interest-scale and twelve branch components; independent arithmetic and finite-space checks. Synthetic evidence only. |
| Within-chart agreement | N/A | No quantitative charts in this review. |
| Complete source details | 0 / 4 | Four live O*NET comparison records retained, including the flat-profile result. Hypothetical score entry, not administered tests. |
| Cross-artifact consistency | 0 / 3 | Medicine, creative-work and trades examples reconciled with live reference results; differences retained. |
| Data-quality controls | 0 / 4 | Unknown, flat, multiple-selection and incomplete-follow-up rules checked. |
| Conclusion support | 0 / 4 | Interest suggestions, explicit career choice, no aptitude inference, and separation from money. Predictive validity and population fairness remain untested. |

Counts are scoped units, not verified passes. Human validation remains unverified. See research/calibration-comparator-review-2026-10-17.md for the professional-practice comparison and pilot design.
